body:
C17 questions for operator (these gate the recommendation):

Q1 — With a deterministic 1.4 s wall-clock Timer representing 14 fight-seconds at 1x, should each exchange remain an atomic, authored outcome while _process only plays a cancellable 1.4 s visual queue; or are we authorizing a model cadence change? The first preserves dvance_exchange()/headless tests; the second requires retiming test and save assumptions.

Q2 — At 2x/4x today the Timer shortens, while the incoming-combo decision pauses the fight for 8 real seconds. Should speed change only visual playback between deterministic exchange outcomes, and must opening the 8 s window freeze both the simulation Timer and the in-flight world animation at every speed before resuming exactly once?

Q3 — For v1, do we approve deterministic presentation-only choreography (no saved position/distance/facing; a seeded visual event consumes nimation_family), or should FightSimulation gain authoritative spatial state now? The latter changes snapshots/save compatibility and the dvance_exchange()-driven test matrix; it needs an explicit migration and seed contract.
topic: C17 operator gates: tick, pause, spatial state
